category_title: Students with visual impairments who use floor-sitting and screaming as task avoidance
minimal_context: The student is traveling down a hallway with a long cane to practice independent walking.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time to travel down the hallway. Hold your long cane and let's walk.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: (Partially holding the student and physically prompting him to walk) Come on, let's walk down the hall.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Agrees to walk independently after walking halfway down the hall)

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Soon drops to the ground again, refusing to move, becoming dead weight and crying)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time to travel down the hallway. Hold your long cane and let's walk.

STUDENT: (Crying and becoming dead weight)

TUTOR: (Partially holding the student and physically prompting him to walk) Come on, let's walk down the hall.

STUDENT: (Agrees to walk independently after walking halfway down the hall)

TUTOR: Keep walking.

STUDENT: (Soon drops to the ground again, refusing to move, becoming dead weight and crying)
